mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 83 degrees with clear skies over Harriet Park, and we are currently under a waxing crescent moon.

The city is preparing for road construction on Highway M beginning August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks, and the Senior Center is looking for volunteers to help with their community programs.

We have a busy weekend ahead, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, along with a girls hockey event today at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Epic User Group Meeting and yoga classes at Insight Wellness.
On Wednesday, August 5, a 37-year-old Madison man was taken into custody on Whalen Road following a probation violation warrant and a brief attempt to flee from officers.
You can cool off today with a delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day at Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM tonight.
